title.narrative: GCF Readiness, Burkina Faso NAP

description.narrative: Mainstraeam adaptation into subnational planning, strenghten institutional frameworks, and develop fiancing strategy and concept notes

The proposed project will support the implementation of Burkina Faso’s NAP by mainstreaming adaptation into subnational planning, strengthening institutional frameworks, and developing financing strategy and concept notes.
